input.question: Which accepted poses contain cross-digit proxy overlaps excluded by imported collision policy?

evidence.note: 19mm lattice with triangular row spacing; 13mm buttons; 4mm height; placement chosen before IK, unmeasured. No ergonomic inference about a real FR-1XB is warranted.

geometry_evidence.note: Uniform hand scaling is not physiological personalization.

provenance.note: Original anatomy. Dimensions are not individualized; range overrides are experimental.

provenance.note: Not button depression; force and travel unknown. Collision gain is numerical.

audit.claim: Collision-filter coverage and rigid-proxy overlap, not tissue feasibility
